About the Scholarship

GLOCAL studies how global economic forces interact with local creative and industrial ecosystems, and it is coordinated from the University of Glasgow. Applications are now open and scholarship applications close on 14 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time for a September 2027 start.

OpportunityGLOCAL – Erasmus Mundus Master in Global Markets, Local Creativities
HostGLOCAL Consortium (University of Glasgow)
LocationGlasgow (multi-country mobility), United Kingdom
Study LevelMaster's
FundingFully Funded
StipendErasmus Mundus scholarships covering tuition and living
Application Deadline14 January 2027
ApplyOfficial application page ↗

GLOCAL studies how global economic forces interact with local creative and industrial ecosystems, and it is coordinated from the University of Glasgow. Applications are now open and scholarship applications close on 14 January 2027 at 13:00 UK time for a September 2027 start.

Programme Highlights

  • Glasgow-coordinated programme with tracks across Europe, Asia and Latin America
  • Scholarship deadline of 14 January 2027 (13:00 UK time), all tracks
  • Interdisciplinary training in economic geography, business history and creativity
  • Alumni in development agencies, cultural policy and global firms

Who Should Apply

Graduates in economics, business, geography, history, sociology and area studies are typical; the consortium reviews motivation and regional interest closely.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships covering tuition and living costs for selected students across all GLOCAL tracks.

Deadline and How to Apply

Apply through the GLOCAL how-to-apply page and submit the scholarship track by 14 January 2027. Key deadline information: 14 January 2027 (13:00 UK time) for scholarship applications across all tracks.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About GLOCAL Consortium (University of Glasgow)

The GLOCAL consortium is coordinated by the University of Glasgow and delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Global Markets, Local Creativities with partner universities across Europe, Asia and Latin America.

Official website: https://globallocal-erasmusmundus.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: 14 January 2027 - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
